title: PXAPI internal analysis record v1
description: The canonical internal artifact of one Analysis Run (Confluence 39846055 §13): a record of references only, never a second copy of any analysis result. It is written for every run, failed and blocked runs included, so no outcome is ever expressed by a missing record: an artifact that was not produced is an explicit null, a delivery that was not attempted is an empty list, and a validation that was known but not executed is written as NOT_RUN. A run in READY or DELIVERED state has produced all nine artifacts, a DELIVERED run references at least one delivery record, and a validation carries a checked_at instant if and only if it was executed.

run_id.description: Required. The Analysis Run this record belongs to.

created_at.description: Required. When this record was written.

state.description: Required. The run's state at the time the record was written. READY and DELIVERED imply that all nine artifacts were produced; DELIVERED implies at least one delivery record.

channel.description: Required. The input channel that raised the run, as the opaque token carried over from the request.

request_ref.description: Required. The accepted analysis-run-request artifact that started the run.

run.description: Required. The run this record belongs to: its state, the channel that raised it and the request that started it.

website_evidence_baseline.description: Required, nullable. The website-evidence artifact of the baseline pass; null if and only if it was not produced.

website_evidence_targeted.description: Required, nullable. The website-evidence artifact of the targeted pass; null if and only if it was not produced.

business_context.description: Required, nullable. The business-context artifact; null if and only if it was not produced.

business_intent_set.description: Required, nullable. The business-intent-set artifact; null if and only if it was not produced.

contextual_diagnosis.description: Required, nullable. The contextual-diagnosis artifact; null if and only if it was not produced.

scorecard.description: Required, nullable. The scorecard artifact; null if and only if it was not produced.

product_diagnosis.description: Required, nullable. The product-diagnosis artifact; null if and only if it was not produced.

client_report_model.description: Required, nullable. The client-report-model artifact, the customer projection; null if and only if it was not produced.

customer_report_render.description: Required, nullable. The rendered customer report artifact; null if and only if it was not produced.

artifacts.description: Required. References to the artifacts of the run, one member per artifact kind. Every member is always present; a member is null if and only if that artifact was not produced, so absence never encodes an outcome. All nine members are non-null for a run in READY or DELIVERED state.

delivery_records.description: Required. The delivery-record artifacts of the run, one per delivery attempt. An empty array means no delivery was attempted; a DELIVERED run has at least one.

measurement_refs.description: Required. The measurement-record artifacts retained for the run. An empty array means no measurement record was retained; it never means nothing was measured.

validations.description: Required. The validations the application recorded for the run. An empty array means the application recorded no validation; a validation that was known but not executed is written with status NOT_RUN, so absence carries no meaning.

validation_id.description: Required. The stable identity of the validation (e.g. a contract conformance check or the customer leakage gate), so that later runs can be compared.

status.description: Required. The outcome of the validation. PASS: it was executed and the run satisfied it. FAIL: it was executed and the run did not satisfy it. NOT_RUN: it was known but not executed; it carries no checked_at instant.

checked_at.description: Required, nullable. When the validation was executed; null if and only if status is NOT_RUN.

detail_ref.description: Optional. A reference to an artifact holding the validation's detail, such as the violations it found. Absent means no detail artifact exists for this validation.
